cards.details: Birth of Siddhartha at Lumbini under a Sal tree.
Mahabhinishkramana: Renunciation of worldly life at age 29.
Sambodhi: Attainment of Enlightenment at Bodh Gaya.
Mahaparinirvana: Final passing away at Kushinagar.

mnemonics.title: Mnemonics & Tricks to Remember
mnemonics.description: Remember the 5 Great Events using a simple acronym.

items.title: B-R-E-D-P
items.decryption: B (Birth - Lotus/Bull), R (Renunciation - Horse), E (Enlightenment - Bodhi Tree), D (Dhamma - Wheel), P (Passing - Stupa).

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Assuming the first sermon was delivered at Bodh Gaya, when it was at Sarnath.
Believing Buddha attained enlightenment immediately after leaving his palace (he spent 6 years wandering).

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Lumbini: Birthplace
  • Bodh Gaya: Enlightenment
  • Sarnath: First Sermon
  • Kushinagar: Death

Personalities

  • Suddhodana: Father (Shakya Clan)
  • Maya: Mother
  • Channa: Charioteer
  • Kanthaka: Horse

Life Stages Mindmap

  • Birth (Janma): Symbols: Lotus & Bull.
  • Great Renunciation (Mahabhinishkramana): Departure at 29, Symbol: Horse.
  • Enlightenment (Nirvana/Sambodhi): Under Peepal tree, Symbol: Bodhi Tree.
  • First Sermon (Dharmachakrapravartana): Deer Park Sarnath, Symbol: Wheel.
  • Great Passing (Mahaparinirvana): Death at 80, Symbol: Stupa.
